name: stream
description: The event stream over a listening server: replay from a cursor in pages, the ready event once replay has caught up, events as they commit, starting at the head, filters and the ids that carry the cursor past what they drop, resuming from Last-Event-ID, heartbeats, and teardown when the client leaves or the engine closes. On Node.js the server is @hono/node-server, on Bun it is Bun.serve.

cases.name: event stream > replays from a cursor in pages, then sends events as they commit
event stream > resumes after Last-Event-ID, which wins over after
event stream > filters by schema and instance
event stream > carries operation events, replayed and as they commit, and no read-only operation
event stream > sends a comment every heartbeat while it waits
event stream > a namespace stream carries its own events and the shared publishes, and none of another namespace
event stream > starts at the head with after=head: no replay, ready at once, and a reconnect resumes where it caught up
event stream > filters drop what they exclude, and an id with no data carries the cursor past it, so a reconnect neither replays nor rescans it
event stream > while it waits, a heartbeat carries the cursor past events the filters dropped
event stream > a stream checks its filters before it answers
